facts.value: Online Master of Public Safety Leadership and Administration – Emergency Medical Services – Mobile Integrated Healthcare

Coursework equips you with the relevant knowledge and experience needed to stand out among the health care industry and improve emergency care systems. With classes in organizational structure, public policy administration and health care finance, you’ll gain the well-rounded skills that are important for a career in emergency health care leadership and administration.
Upon completion of this program, you’ll be prepared to lead and improve EMS teams in mobile integrated health care.
leadership positions in different types of EMS agencies, such as hospitals, public health departments and managed care organizations.
